{{Quote|C'mon, our merchants are waiting inside. Can you hurry it up?|Female rebel|<ref name="A War on Two Fronts">{{TCW|A War on Two Fronts}}</ref>}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] was among the many '''rebels''' who lived on [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] when the [[Sanjay Rash/Legends|Onderon king]] affiliated with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].

==Biography==
The woman joined the [[Onderon rebels/Legends|Onderon rebels]] to recapture the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. She fought in the [[Battle of Onderon/Legends|Battle of Onderon]] and later played a part in [[Lux Bonteri/Legends|Lux Bonteri's]] plan to get into the capital city of [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]], convincing the [[Battle droid/Legends|Battle droid]] sentries that they had just been hunting and needed to sell their goods to merchants inside the city. The female rebel was later present at the palace square, where Dendup's execution was going to take place, and protested along with the other rebels.

==Behind the scenes==
The female rebel is voiced by [[Dawn-Lyen Gardner]] who voices [[Steela Gerrera/Legends|Steela Gerrera]] in [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]].
